title: Claims command output
description: Stable JSON printed by `python3 -m scripts.article claims quote-check` and `claims rebase` (decisions 0075 and 0080). Neither prints source text.

results.description: quote-check: one record per source-claim node.

source.description: Text file read: the legacy file, or the normalized text of the addressed edition.

cached.description: Recorded tier 2 verdict for exactly these inputs.

stale.description: The address names a superseded edition.

current_hash.description: Normalized hash of the current edition, when stale.

reason.description: Why an address could not be resolved.

status.description: rebase: current (nothing to change), proposed (a human accepts or rejects), quote-missing (the quote is not in the current edition), no-locator (the quote is there, but no section or paragraph holds it whole).

address.description: rebase: the address the node has now.

proposed.description: rebase: the address to put in `locator`.
